hooks.text: Shortly before 10 a.m., New York’s tallest skyscraper vanished into fog.
A B-25 bomber pilot was flying blind through the Manhattan fog.
An elevator operator survived falling 75 stories inside a metal box.

title: The B-25 That Struck the Empire State Building 🤯
description: On July 28, 1945, a B-25 struck the Empire State Building in fog. Elevator operator Betty Lou Oliver survived a 75-floor plunge. Records confirm the survival but do not establish why the fall was survivable. Archival crash photos and a labeled representative aircraft image illustrate the account.
